name: BYOC-16
description: The original accumulator machine: registers A and B, an ALU, a stack in the MMU, an LCD and a colour screen. Instructions work on A and B.
tagline: The original accumulator machine, with a stack

programs.name: Hello, world on the LCD
programs.description: Loops over a string with an index in B

programs.name: Fibonacci on the LCD
programs.description: Prints the 16 bit Fibonacci numbers in decimal

programs.name: Colour gradient on the screen
programs.description: Red left to right, green top to bottom
